units.source_text: 总而言之，这些日子活现在舅舅家仓库角落的一个皮包里，如今唤醒了我的记忆。

en.t: In short, these days lay alive in a leather bag in the corner of my uncle's storehouse, and now they have awakened my memory.

units.source_text: 这个皮包，是我那位当医生的父亲出诊时携带的。

en.t: This leather bag was the one my father, who was a doctor, carried when he went out on house calls.

units.source_text: 我舅舅搞投机买卖，最近破产，连房屋地产都失去了。

en.t: My uncle had been involved in speculative business, but he recently went bankrupt and even lost his house and land.

units.source_text: 他将仓库移交别人之前，我心里想，自己会不会有什么东西放在那里呢。

en.t: Before he handed the storehouse over to someone else, I wondered whether I might have left something there.

units.source_text: 我去寻找，便发现这个上了锁的皮包。

en.t: I went to look, and found this locked leather bag.

units.source_text: 我拿起旁边的旧刀，将皮包破开，看见里面塞满了我少年时代的日记。

en.t: I picked up an old knife nearby, cut the leather bag open, and saw that it was stuffed with diaries from my youth.
These diaries were mixed in among them as well.

units.source_text: 我同被忘却了的过去中的诚实心情见面了。

en.t: I came face to face with the honest feelings of a forgotten past.

units.source_text: 日记里祖父的形象比我记忆中祖父的形象要难看得多。

en.t: The image of my grandfather in the diaries was far uglier than the image of him in my memory.

units.source_text: 因为这十年间，祖父的形象在我的记忆中已渐渐被淡忘得一干二净了。

en.t: That was because over these ten years, the image of my grandfather had gradually faded from my memory until almost nothing remained.
